T: Crooks always come undone. Dinner doesn't.
D: A Melbourne teenager moves in with his grandmother and her family of armed robbers.
P: Serve the mains when Smurf puts dinner on the table for her boys.
S: Lamb shoulder strips marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled hot, wrapped in small pieces of warm pita with tomato, onion and garlic yoghurt.
the boys on the couch with the footy on
Sausage mince with grated onion, carrot and herbs rolled in puff pastry, egg washed, sesame on top, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Tomato sauce.
a bowl on the coffee table at the Cody house
French onion dip of onions cooked slowly 40 minutes, folded through sour cream and cream cheese with chives, and thick ridged chips.
M: Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted at 180C to 58C, rested, with roast potatoes and pumpkin, peas and gravy.
Chicken breast crumbed and fried, topped with ham, Napoli sauce and mozzarella, grilled until bubbling, with chips and salad.
W: Puff pastry sheets baked flat, filled with a thick vanilla custard set with cornflour, topped with passionfruit icing, chilled and cut.
K: a cold one at the local pub
Australian lager poured into chilled pot glasses straight from the fridge, a bowl of chips on the bar.

s.how: Cut 600g lamb shoulder into strips and marinate in lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil for an hour. Grill on high until charred. Wrap small pieces in torn warm pita with sliced tomato, onion and a spoon of garlic yoghurt, then pin with toothpicks.

s.note: a bowl on the coffee table at the Cody house
s.how: Slice 3 onions thinly and cook in butter over low heat for 40 minutes until deep golden. Cool, then fold through 300ml sour cream and 125g softened cream cheese with chopped chives and salt. Chill for an hour and serve with a big bowl of ridged potato chips.

m.how: Halve 2 chicken breasts and crumb them in flour, egg and panko. Shallow fry until golden and cooked through. Top with sliced ham, a spoon of crushed tomato simmered with garlic, and grated mozzarella. Grill until bubbling and serve with hot chips and a green salad.

w.how: Bake 2 puff pastry sheets flat between trays at 200C until crisp. Whisk 750ml milk, 3 eggs, 150g sugar and 80g cornflour over heat until very thick. Spread between the sheets in a lined tin. Ice with icing mixed with passionfruit pulp, chill overnight and cut.

d.note: a cold one at the local pub
d.how: Chill the lager and the pot glasses in the fridge for at least an hour. Pour each one slowly down the side of the tilted glass, straightening up at the end for a small head. Set a bowl of chips on the bench for everyone to share.
